options.name: api_version_number
options.description: A specific version number to use for the API call. If not included, will use the highest version by default

options.name: component
options.description: The type of component to be updated. Values are vc and esxi.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname of the vCenter or ESXi host

options.name: password
options.description: The password for the management account to be stored in VxRail Manager

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for getting telemetry information, the default value is 60 seconds

options.name: username
options.description: The username for the management account

options.name: vcadmin
options.description: Administrative account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vcpasswd
options.description: The password for the administrator account provided in vcadmin

options.name: vxmip
options.description: The IP address of the VxRail Manager System
